title: P1 agent context and mutation parity
summary: Deliver and mutate canonical context consistently across Pi, MCP, Web UI, and work-start boundaries.
description: Accepted Decisions read/load/start delivery and CRUD; Pi/MCP/Web UI mutation parity; phase-discuss readiness; precise linked-requirement attestation.
goals: A canonical field that is attested as read or advertised as mutable must be delivered and managed consistently on every supported surface.
nonGoals: Changing user-authored decision semantics without migration
Making system-owned timestamps or session attestations editable
risks: Broadening payloads can exceed transport limits unless outputs remain bounded
Backward compatibility must preserve existing tool parameters
completionCriteria: Full reads contain all canonical context needed for attestation
Accepted Decisions have explicit supported management paths
Pi/MCP/Web UI mutation fields and governance outcomes are equivalent
Only delivered and target-relevant Requirements become attested

tasks.title: Deliver Accepted Decisions in canonical full reads and work context
tasks.description:
Include project, feature, phase, and task Accepted Decisions in bounded canonical full-read outputs, MCP planner-load agentContext, Pi agent-only context, and task-start phase context where relevant. Update read-attestation semantics so a full read is never certified while canonical decision context was omitted, preserve transport ceilings, and add Pi/MCP/load/start regressions.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented canonical Accepted Decision delivery across plan-core, Pi, and MCP. Feature, phase, and task full reads now render and return every accepted decision field (id, title, decision, rationale, implementationNotes, acceptedAt) before recording read attestations. New markCanonicalFullReadForSessionId mechanically rejects title-only or otherwise omitted Accepted Decision context, including a required explicit zero-decision marker. Task-start context now includes bounded project/feature/phase/task Accepted Decisions for the active lineage alongside linked Requirements. Pi plan_get and agent-only before_agent_start context include project and bounded cross-entity decision context; MCP planner-show exposes project decisions and planner-load returns bounded typed Accepted Decision agentContext with total/truncation metadata. Ambient/load/task-start decision context is capped at 8,000 characters with explicit full-read guidance when truncated, and regressions prove it does not leak into human recap text. Updated tool descriptions, canonical/generated planner skill guidance, and P2 capability surfaces. Verification: full pnpm build and pnpm check passed; pnpm test:coverage passed 569/569 Node tests and 96/96 Web UI tests; pnpm plugins:check and git diff --check passed. After the final no-recap-leak assertions, focused MCP/Pi tests passed 27/27 and diff check remained clean. No Web UI runtime changed, so Playwright was not rerun. Files include packages/plan-core/src/task-context.ts, packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, targeted tests, planner skill copies, and test/surfaces.mjs. No commit, push, PR, or merge performed.

tasks.title: Add Accepted Decisions management parity
tasks.description:
Provide explicit project and entity Accepted Decisions create/update/delete workflows across plan-core, Pi, MCP, plan-server, and Web UI. Preserve decision IDs, acceptedAt, rationale, implementationNotes, user confirmation, and planner-owned metadata; avoid raw array replacement where safer semantic operations are required; cover migrations and audit history.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented explicit semantic Accepted Decisions create/update/delete parity for project, feature, phase, and task owners across plan-core, plan-server HTTP APIs, MCP tools, Pi tools, and the Web UI. PlanStore operations preserve decision IDs and acceptedAt on update, avoid whole-array replacement, return typed NO_MUTABLE_FIELDS_RECEIVED, ACCEPTED_DECISION_NOT_FOUND, and ACCEPTED_DECISION_TARGET_NOT_FOUND failures without mutation, and require explicit confirmation before deletion. The Web UI provides accessible closed-by-default management forms, safe redirects, explicit irreversible-delete confirmation, and desktop/mobile create-update-delete flows. Shared planner skill inventories and the P2 capability surface manifest include all new contracts. Legacy explicit project-context migration behavior and planner-owned metadata remain preserved. Verification: affected builds and focused semantic suites passed; full pnpm build and pnpm check passed; pnpm test:coverage passed 562/562 repository tests and 95/95 Web UI tests with FINAL coverage 87.10% lines, 74.13% branches, 82.90% functions; pnpm plugins:check passed; Playwright accepted-decisions, handoff-resume, and responsive suites passed 12/12 on chromium/mobile-chromium; git diff --check passed. No commit, push, PR, or merge was performed.

MCP and Pi discovery count expectations were updated, but the complete focused suite has not yet passed and T369 must resume from verification and remaining coverage.

tasks.title: Align feature phase and task mutation and discuss governance parity
tasks.description:
Close Pi/MCP/Web UI field mismatches for feature, phase, and task updates, including phase relinking/goals/non-goals/dependencies/risks/questions/completion criteria, task notes/decisions, and registered phase-discuss readiness. Preserve derived-status read-only rules and human-supervisor exemptions while adding compatibility-safe typed responses.

---
**Completion summary:**
Completed cross-harness feature, phase, and task mutation/discuss parity. MCP phase updates now persist feature relinking plus descriptionRef, goals, non-goals, dependencies, risks, open questions, decisions, and completion criteria; MCP task updates persist descriptionRef, notes, decisions, and checklist values. Pi now registers phase_discuss with typed readiness outcomes, exposes the canonical phase/task fields, and rejects deprecated raw Accepted Decisions replacement through ACCEPTED_DECISION_SEMANTIC_MUTATION_REQUIRED. Plan-server update routes preserve Web UI human-supervisor task-transition exemptions, normalize empty descriptionRef values as removal, reject direct feature/phase derived-status changes through DERIVED_STATUS_READ_ONLY, and reject unsafe raw Accepted Decisions replacement while tolerating unchanged deprecated compatibility payloads. Web UI edit flows expose description references, phase parent relinking/planning fields, and task notes/decisions/motivation/checklist; feature and phase derived-status controls are disabled without changing established layout. Canonical skill and capability inventories include phase_discuss and the parity surfaces. Verification passed: pnpm build; pnpm check; pnpm test:coverage (564/564 repository tests and 96/96 Web UI tests); pnpm plugins:check; full Playwright desktop/mobile suite (40/40); git diff --check. All five task checklist items were verified and completed. No remaining T370 work or unverified behavior; no commit, push, PR, or merge performed.

tasks.title: Scope Requirement read attestations to delivered linked context
tasks.description:
Refine packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts and Pi/MCP requirement read flows so starting work requires and reuses only linked Requirements actually delivered to the session, rather than marking every top-level Requirement read after a broad list. Preserve any-order freshness, Project Guidelines gates, sibling-task reuse, and precise missing/stale diagnostics.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented target-scoped Requirement read attestations across plan-core, Pi, and MCP. Broad requirement_list/planner-requirement-list calls remain backward-compatible inventories but no longer attest every Requirement. Supplying phaseRef resolves the exact phase plus owning feature, delivers only deduplicated linked Requirements, and records only those IDs for the current logical session. task_start/task_switch nextActions now request the exact scoped phaseRef, expose requirementEligibility with precise missing/stale Requirement IDs, preserve any-order reads, fresh persisted/in-memory reuse, sibling-task reuse, Project Guidelines gates, and atomic denial behavior. Updated canonical/generated planner skill guidance and P2 capability surfaces/scenario coverage. Verification: focused builds passed for core/MCP/Pi; focused core/Pi/MCP/lifecycle/matrix tests passed 168/168; full pnpm build, pnpm check, pnpm test:coverage passed 564/564 Node tests and 96/96 Web UI tests; pnpm plugins:check and git diff --check passed. No Playwright rerun because this task changed no Web UI runtime code. Files include packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, their targeted tests, packages/plan-core/planner-skill.md and generated plugin copies, test/surfaces.mjs, and test/scenario-matrix.mjs. Separate planned P097(F021)/T386 captures the newly reported multi-agent concurrent task-start issue. No commit, push, PR, or merge performed.
